site_tagline: The tools big Minecraft modpacks are missing
footer_disclaimer: Fan-made site, not affiliated with the All the Mods team, Mojang or the mod authors.
home_title: Which cross gives that bee? It's in here.
home_lead: With 500 mods, the quest book and JEI aren't enough to plan ahead. Every tree and recipe here comes out of the game files, not from a wiki someone wrote from memory.
home_why_1: A script reads the mods' recipes and lang files, then builds the pages. When ATM ships an update, we run it again and the site follows.
home_why_2: Your progress stays in your browser. No account needed.
tool_bees_desc: Every Productive Bees bee with its parents, tier and how to get it. Tick the ones you have and see what unlocks next.
tool_quests_desc: The pack's quests with search and a checkbox to keep track of where you are.
tool_howto_desc: Type an item and see the whole crafting chain, including the recipes ATM changed.
bees_meta: Interactive Productive Bees breeding tree for {pack}: {n} bees with their nests, conversions and tiers. Tick what you have to see what's next.

js.foot: Hover a slot to see what it needs, click for details. Drag to move around. Tier counts the steps from a wild bee. Data: Productive Bees 1.21.1, Productive Metalworks and ATM10 recipes. Your progress stays in this browser.
js.state_lock: Locked: you're missing a parent bee
js.toast_nothing: Nothing new yet, but you'll need it later.
js.k_conversion: Conversion: right-click the bee with the item
js.k_item_conversion: The bee transforms an item in its hive

tool_mods_desc: All {n} mods in the pack, sorted by type. The complicated ones get a guide with exact rules and build schematics.
mods_meta: Full list of the {n} mods in {pack}, sorted by type, with guides checked against the mods' code: multiblocks, crafting chains, schematics.
mods_lead: The list comes from the pack's own mod list. Decoration, quality-of-life and library mods are just listed; the ones that need explaining have (or will have) a guide.
guide_meta: {mod} in {pack}: exact multiblock rules, build schematics and crafting chains, checked against the mod's code and the pack's config.
guide_schematic: Minimal schematic (top view, layer by layer)
